summary: Rutherford County tower site at 882 ft; Tennessee Landforms marks the tower removed. A hiking app lists a loop trail over the summit.

facts.status_note: Tennessee Landforms lists the tower as removed; no removal date found.

visit.trail_note: A hiking-app listing describes a loop trail of about 3.1 miles to the summit from a car-accessible trailhead. The listing does not mention a tower.

events.note: Tennessee Landforms waypoint RUT001 is marked removed. No year given.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Landforms waypoint is the only tower-specific source. The hiiker.app page is a generic trail listing; its history text (stone walls, foundations) is unsourced and was not used. The Landforms code '5-11' is not explained on the site and is not interpreted. No build, staffing or removal date was found. The story is below the 120-word floor because the evidence supports no more. Two searches for a tower history found nothing usable.
